name: placed
says: What a side strikes, in atomic, is what the description's `struck` says (a place beside a side's own leader is not struck by that side's units; the description's `check` reads `struck`, not `attacked`). The base text's definition of the question is replaced by the one over `struck`; nothing else of the base changes.

questions.says: the places a side's units strike, the board as it stands
